plans.goal: Charge straight through the mine carts barricade, pushing them aside

atoms.text: Dash forward toward the handcarts blocking the mine mouth
Shove the handcart at 7,6 out of the way
Shove the handcart at 9,6 to the side
Sprint past the barricade into the mine

plans.goal: Ignite oil and flammables to destroy the barricade, then push through

atoms.strategy: start a big fire on the barricade
atoms.text: Ignite the lamp-oil barrel at 8,4 with a torch

atoms.strategy: spread fire to the barricade carts
atoms.text: Throw burning oil at the handcarts to light them up
Shove the burning handcart at 7,6 aside
Sprint into the mine mouth while the barricade burns

plans.goal: Have companions hold the enemies while I wreck the barricade

atoms.text: Borin, hold the center against Grist and Pell
Pip, watch for Rook's arrows from the left
Dash to the handcarts while my friends hold them off
Shove the handcart at 7,6 hard to smash it
Kick the other handcart out of the way
Sprint into the mine and disappear
